findings.basis: 310-30 'Truphone Zz', 310-70 and 310-90 'ATT Broadband' are two-digit MNC renderings of vendor.xml entries written as mnc="30", "70" and "90". DefaultCarrierConfigService matches mnc by exact string (DefaultCarrierConfigService.java:360-364) and US SIMs report three-digit MNCs, so these entries never applied to a real SIM on the source devices.
findings.effect: allow_merging_rtt_calls_bool (CarrierConfigManager.java:797-802, default false at :11835) has a single reader: TelephonyConnection.isRttMergeSupported (TelephonyConnection.java:2153-2155), called from refreshConferenceSupported (TelephonyConnection.java:3279-3304). An emergency connection is made non-conferenceable before the RTT check is reached (TelephonyConnection.java:3280-3282). For a non-emergency RTT connection, true lets the user merge it into a conference, which per the key's definition downgrades it to voice; false withholds the merge. The AOSP ImsStack (tree and OCD fork), frameworks/opt/telephony, frameworks/opt/net/ims, Telecom and the Dialer do not read it; the Dialer's own RTT-conference workaround is independent of it (DialerCall.java:924-945). On this ROM RTT connections arise only from incoming RTT calls, because config_support_rtt is false, so the key matters only when the user presses Merge during an incoming RTT call. Telephony's own RTT gates also need R.bool.config_support_rtt, which is false in this tree (packages/services/Telephony/res/values/config.xml:234-235, config_support_simless_emergency_rtt false at :259-261) with no overlay in device/samsung/x1s, device/samsung/universal9830-common or rom-repos/android_vendor_extra: PhoneInterfaceManager.isRttSupported/isRttEnabled (PhoneInterfaceManager.java:7995-8035), the PhoneAccount CAPABILITY_RTT bit (TelecomAccountRegistry.java:441-446, 1102-1155) and the accessibility RTT switch (AccessibilitySettingsFragment.java:267-276) are all off, so the stock Dialer never offers or upgrades to RTT (DialerCall.java:1024-1052). Telecom still creates RTT streams for an incoming RTT call (CallsManager.java:1809-1816) and for an outgoing emergency call when the calling app passes EXTRA_START_CALL_WITH_RTT, ignoring the account capability (CallsManager.java:2650-2662). Read on the LineageOS 23.2 tree; the phone runs 24.0, whose config_support_rtt was not checked. The OCD ImsStack fork (branch ocd) is byte-identical to the tree in every ImsStack file cited.
findings.risk: Little exposure, because no real SIM is known to match these profiles, and their rtt_supported_bool is held in candidate 27, which leaves this key inert. The hold rests on the basis, not on the effect.

notes: Hold. The basis cannot be tied to a real SIM (dead two-digit MNC renderings); Android's default false stays.
